_help.capacity_hours: Hours a week this person is actually available.
_help.committed_hours: Hours a week already spoken for.
_help.responsibilities: What they own, not what they did last week.
_help.deadlines: due is YYYY-MM-DD, status is on_track, at_risk, or done.
_help.blockers: What is stopping them, and who has to unblock it.
_help.overload_threshold: Utilisation above this counts as overloaded.
_help.idle_threshold: Utilisation below this counts as spare capacity.
